mainEntity.name: Who qualifies for CTEC experience in lieu?

acceptedAnswer.text: Former California CPAs, attorneys and enrolled agents who held that status for the most recent two years; employees of a CPA, attorney or EA who prepared returns in that job in the two most recent years; out-of-state CPAs, attorneys and EAs; and out-of-state employees of those professionals who have relocated to California.

mainEntity.name: Do I still need a Live Scan, PTIN and bond?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Experience in lieu only replaces the 60 hour qualifying education. You still complete the Live Scan background check, get an IRS PTIN, buy a $5,000 surety bond and register with CTEC.

mainEntity.name: How many returns must I have prepared?

acceptedAnswer.text: You sign, under penalty of perjury, that you prepared at least 100 tax returns for compensation in the two years before your application.

mainEntity.name: How long do I have to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Complete the 15 hour California tax course within 18 months, and finish all initial registration requirements within 3 years of starting your application.

Like every CRTP you renew by October 31 each year: complete the 20 hour CTEC course (10 hours federal tax law, 3 hours federal updates, 2 hours ethics, 5 hours California tax law), keep your PTIN and bond current and pay the renewal fees.

mainEntity.name: I moved to California from another state. Does this apply to me?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can. CTEC says preparers who relocated to California after preparing returns in another state for the most recent two years complete a 15 hour qualifying California tax course. Contact CTEC to confirm your eligibility before you apply.
